pages.title: Hero of the Illage
pages.text: Drink an $(l:raidborn:utility_and_items/essences)Overlord Essence$() to gain Hero of the Illage. This permanent alliance effect makes Illagers friendly toward you.

pages.title: Alliance Rules
pages.text: Hero of the Illage provides 15 recruitment slots by default. It removes Bad Omen and is not lost when you attack or kill an Illager-side creature.

pages.title: Village Relations
pages.text: While any Raidborn alliance effect is active, Villager interaction is blocked, Iron Golems treat you as hostile, and Hero of the Village cannot be gained.
